snippet.title: X-Wing Revival 0.5 Alpha (2025-05-04)
snippet.description:
Download: https://www.raptor007.com/x-wing-revival/

X-Wing Revival v0.5 is here!  Written from scratch in C++ to play somewhat similar to the 90's classic X-Wing games, but compatible with modern systems and internet play with a dedicated online server.  Now with positional voice chat, improved graphics and sound, better targeting detail, and a bunch of bug fixes.

Source Code:
https://github.com/Raptor007/X-Wing-Revival
https://github.com/Raptor007/RaptorEngine

Ship models were shamelessly pilfered from X-Wing Alliance asset files, including some beautiful high-res models from the X-Wing Alliance Upgrade Project circa 2012.  If you like Star Wars flight sims, be sure to check out their latest improvements to XWA:
https://xwaupgrade.com/
